ideas.idea: Show products as text with prices, materials, sizes and links on the Catalogue page
ideas.why: Richer product detail is accurate but is broad content advice, and the catalogue is fetched client-side so it hinges on the rendering fix.

ideas.idea: Give each mug its own page and URL
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx lists only names with no per-item route in main.jsx, so individual mugs cannot be linked or found on their own.

ideas.idea: Add Organization JSON-LD with name and location
ideas.why: Home.jsx states a Bristol handmade mug business and there is no structured data, so Organization markup would state it in a machine-readable way.

ideas.idea: Add viewport meta and Open Graph tags
ideas.why: index.html has only charset, so the gap is real, but this is standard advice for any site and has little effect on being found.

ideas.idea: Add a text link to the catalogue in the Home page body
ideas.why: Home has no body link, but the nav Link fix already covers the real problem and an extra link adds little.
Home promises worldwide shipping but no page explains ordering, costs or delivery times, which people and machines would look for.

ideas.idea: Set per-route titles and descriptions with a head helper
ideas.why: Both routes share one static title, and a head helper per route gives each page its own title and description.

ideas.idea: Declare a domain and absolute canonical URLs
ideas.why: No canonical or declared domain exists in the code, so adding a canonical for each page is a concrete fix.
